1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, __wherein the control means comprises a microprocessor-based controller arranged to execute a braking algorithm that dynamically adjusts valve operation based on real-time feedback from multiple sensors to achieve anti-lock braking functionality__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __a plurality of first valves and a plurality of second valves, wherein the valves are arranged in a specific configuration to enable independent modulation of braking pressure at different rates__.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves comprise __at least one larger valve arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and at least one smaller valve arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, the smaller valve being operatively controlled to modulate pressure changes at a rate faster than the larger valve__.

4. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at __a high speed of at least 100 Hz to enable rapid pressure modulation__.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein __the first and second valves are each independently driven by binary solenoid actuators that are controlled by the microprocessor-based controller to achieve proportional braking force modulation__.

6. (Original) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from __a vehicle speed sensor and a longitudinal acceleration sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, __an optimum braking pressure for each wheel based on wheel slip calculations and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum braking pressure__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising __at least one air braking unit according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; a central compressed air storage tank; and a vehicle-level electronic control module in communication with the control means of each air braking unit to coordinate braking across multiple wheels__.
